g.text: A differential pair steers its tail current according to the difference between inputs

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c
font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: Matched NPN pair with ideal constant tail current, forward-active operation and α≈1. Both collectors have equal resistive loads; outputs are inverted with

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: respect to their own increasing collector current. Tail-source compliance, input common-mode range, mismatch and finite tail resistance limit actual CMRR.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: Supply rails are conceptual; no device or headroom values are assigned.
